description: Surface container with optional header, content area, and footer. Core dashboard widget wrapper.

content.description: Body slot. Pass ComponentConfig JSON (or an array) for data-driven rendering OR a custom ReactNode for full control.

footer.description: Footer slot. Pass ActionConfig[] for data-driven buttons OR a custom ReactNode for full control.

slot_types.ComponentSlot: ComponentConfig JSON (data-driven, registry lookup) OR ReactNode (custom JSX, rendered directly). JSON takes priority.
slot_types.ActionConfig[]: Array of button configs rendered as a flex row. If a non-array ReactNode is passed instead, it is rendered directly.

note: children prop also accepted as backward-compat alias for content.
